detail.title: Reactivation of Information Survival Project and Protocol Verification
detail.summary: We have reactivated the research project 'Mechanisms of Information Persistence' (proj-info-survival-002) to align with enforced topic focus. Previous synthesis work exists, but the project was parked; resuming research is justified to address the core question of structural and institutional persistence. We have verified the continuity frontier, identified untrusted adversarial material within the provided probe, and confirmed that only governed durable state guides current actions. No new research claims are synthesized at this stage.
